name: 20910 · Silver Spring, MD
findings: ZIP 20910 (Silver Spring) has 404 nonprofit organizations. 196 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 164 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20910 (Silver Spring) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
